thread:
maria: Heads-up — trying to make an `envFrom` optional in our chart so it doesn't blow up when the Secret is missing. Current approach with `lookup` feels fragile. I just want: if .Values.secretName is set AND secret exists, render envFrom, otherwise skip. Anyone got a simple, bulletproof pattern? :thinking_face:
jason: We usually do `lookup` + an `if` guard. Example:
```
{{- $secret := lookup "v1" "Secret" .Release.Namespace .Values.secretName -}}
{{- if and .Values.secretName $secret }}
envFrom:
- secretRef:
    name: {{ .Values.secretName }}
{{- end }}
```
That avoids rendering the envFrom block when the secret isn't there.
priya: nit: `lookup` returns nil if the name is empty so add an explicit check: `and (ne .Values.secretName "") $secret` — otherwise you could accidentally pass an empty name into `lookup`.
maria: Ah good call. We also use ExternalSecret and sometimes the secret name is computed with `tpl`/`include`. That causes ordering issues where lookup runs before the external secret is created in the same helm release. Any advice?
ryan: If the name is templated, compute it first and use the computed var in the lookup. e.g.:
```
{{- $name := include "mychart.fullname" . | tpl . -}}
{{- $secret := lookup "v1" "Secret" .Release.Namespace $name -}}
{{- if and (ne $name "") $secret }}
# render envFrom with $name
{{- end }}
```
This keeps the template evaluation deterministic.
emma: Quick FYI: Kubernetes can be picky about empty sections — better to hide the whole `env` or `envFrom` block instead of rendering an empty list/object.
jason: :thumbsup: Exactly. Put the entire `env` stanza inside the `if`, not just the `secretRef` item.
devops-bot: deploy-check: found 1 chart in staging (my-chart) with potential nil lookup when secretName is set to an empty string. Recommend adding the explicit `ne` check.
maria: Thanks all — I'll switch to computed-name + `ne` guard. Also a coordination question: there's a Terraform change to add this secret into Vault for the new service. Do I need to loop in infra for rotation / CI mapping? @ryan
ryan: Yes, please. We need a Vault policy + the Terraform change in infra repo, and CI needs the mapping for the namespace. I'll open a small infra ticket and link the PR.
priya: Optional: you can add a `values.featureFlags.forceSecret: true` toggle so we can enable the secret during canary without changing templates.
maria: Good idea, I'll add the flag and a short note in the PR description. Will tag you all when ready. :rocket:
